calc_mse: calculate the mean square error between two PyTorch tensors x and y
calc_psnr: calculate the peak signal-to-noise ratio between two PyTorch tensors x and y
sample_images_at_mc_locs: sample target images at Monte Carlo ray pixel locations using bilinear interpolation
test_calc_mse: test the calc_mse function by computing MSE between two random PyTorch tensors
refactor_calc_psnr: refactor the calc_psnr function to add a safeguard against zero MSE values
